prompt.zh-TW: 晨光健身房今年營業活動收到的現金剛好等於付出去的現金，「營業活動的現金流量總計」是 {{money:vars.ocf}}；年底流動負債 {{money:vars.cl}}。現金流量比率是多少？
prompt.en: This year Morning Light Gym’s operating receipts exactly equalled its operating payments, so net cash from operating activities is {{money:vars.ocf}}; current liabilities at year end are {{money:vars.cl}}. What is the cash flow ratio?

explanation.zh-TW: 分母存在（{{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}} {{money:vars.cl}}），所以比率算得出來；分子剛好是零，結果就是零。這和分母為零的 N/A 不同：零是「算出來剛好沒有」，N/A 是「根本沒得算」。
explanation.en: The denominator exists ({{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}} of {{money:vars.cl}}), so the ratio can be calculated; the numerator happens to be zero, so the result is zero. This differs from the N/A of a zero denominator: zero is ‘calculated and there is none’, N/A is ‘nothing to calculate’.
